<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>In the per-module summary, it summarizes the byte offset applied to each pointer parameter before passing to each corresponding callee.</p>


<p>In the combined summary, it's empty and information is propagated by inter-procedural analysis and applied to the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> field.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The range contains byte offsets from the parameter pointer which accessed by the function.</p>


<p>In the per-module summary, it only includes accesses made by the function instructions. In the combined summary, it also includes accesses by nested function calls.</p>
